About RAAHHI TOURS

A real team for your travel plans

RAAHHI TOURS is the trading name of Raahi Tourism PVT LTD, registered in India. We help you create memories of a lifetime through personal travel planning and clear, human support.

Pune office: Sr No 33/2, Ashtavinayak Rd, MITCON Lane, Balewadi, Pune, Maharashtra 411045, India.

Support hours: 8:00 am–9:00 pm IST (UTC+05:30). Speak with a real sales executive on WhatsApp, call +91 7678572029 or email inquire@raahhi.com.

What RAAHHI TOURS does

  • Visa assistance for 40 destinations: understanding the visa options, confirming current requirements and fees, and preparing the information an application needs.
  • UAE activities: 36 desert safaris, city tours, landmarks, theme parks, water parks, cruises and adventure activities in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Ras Al Khaimah.
  • UAE holiday packages: 25 multi-day itineraries based in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Ras Al Khaimah, each listing its inclusions.

How enquiries work

  1. Choose a visa destination, activity or holiday package and select Start Visa Enquiry or Enquire.
  2. Enter your details. The website prepares a summary of your enquiry. It is not sent automatically.
  3. Use the WhatsApp or email button to open your message and press Send. A human sales executive helps you plan the trip. The team confirms prices, availability and requirements.

Nothing is booked or paid for on this website.

Where RAAHHI TOURS operates

  • UAE activities in Dubai (23), Abu Dhabi (11) and Ras Al Khaimah (2).
  • UAE holiday packages based in Dubai (15), Abu Dhabi (5) and Ras Al Khaimah (6).
  • Visa assistance for 40 destinations worldwide.

How information on this website is presented

  • Activity, package and visa details come from the RAAHHI TOURS catalogue. Prices, hotel names and pickup times that are not recorded are confirmed on enquiry. The page does not substitute estimates.
  • Visa pages link to the official government or tourism-authority source recorded for each destination. The visa type, validity and processing time shown are catalogue values that our team confirms for your trip.
  • Record claims, such as the tallest building or the fastest roller coaster, are only stated with their source (Guinness World Records) and the date the record page was checked.
  • Photos come from Unsplash, Pexels and Wikimedia Commons. Depending on what is verifiably available, a product's photos may be an exact photograph of that attraction, an exact photograph of its location or operator, a historically accurate photograph, or a representative real photograph of a similar experience; a representative photograph does not imply that the venue, operator or vessel pictured is necessarily the one you book. Photos whose licence requires credit are credited beneath the image.
  • Activity browse lists follow catalogue order; search results follow how closely the query matches recorded information. Related suggestions stay within the same destination and use comparison groups, categories, listed duration or package itinerary stops. None of these is a popularity ranking.

Our editorial standards

RAAHHI TOURS prepares the planning guidance on this website from recorded product information, official destination sources and the practical choices travellers need to make. We distinguish supplier facts, government guidance and our own planning suggestions. Our comparisons explain differences; they do not claim a sales or popularity ranking.

Government guidance is linked next to the claims it supports, with the scope and review date. A checked link does not verify every statement on a page. Product options, price references and cancellation rules have separate source records; final availability and your complete quote are confirmed by a human executive.

We do not publish fabricated reviews, ratings, team qualifications or firsthand visits. Photographs may be representative where stated. To report an error, email inquire@raahhi.com with the page link and the detail to check. Editorial contact: Raahi Tourism PVT LTD, Pune, India.

What RAAHHI TOURS does not control

  • Visa decisions and processing times, which are set by the relevant government or immigration authority. RAAHHI TOURS does not guarantee visa approval or processing times.
  • Supplier terms for activities and hotels, such as cancellation policies, which are confirmed for each product when you enquire.

RAAHHI TOURS policies

Terms of service

Personal travel support, clear quotations and written confirmation before you commit.

Who you are dealing with

RAAHHI TOURS is the trading name of Raahi Tourism PVT LTD, a company registered in India. Our office is at Sr No 33/2, Ashtavinayak Rd, MITCON Lane, Balewadi, Pune, Maharashtra 411045, India. Contact inquire@raahhi.com or +91 7678572029 during 8:00 am–9:00 pm IST.

From enquiry to booking

This website helps you explore activities, holidays and visa assistance. Forms prepare your details locally. Choose WhatsApp or email, review the prefilled message and press Send in that app to reach a real sales executive. Preparing a summary or opening an app does not send it, reserve inventory, submit a visa application or take payment.

Our team checks your dates, party and preferences, explains the available options, and provides a quotation. Review the named service, total amount, currency, inclusions, exclusions, cancellation conditions and payment instructions before accepting. A booking exists only when we issue written confirmation; an enquiry or payment request alone is not a ticket or confirmation.

Prices, currencies and payment

Starting prices apply to the stated option and pricing basis. Dated option references apply only to the recorded date and traveller basis. They do not establish a group total or live availability. Hotel upgrades, private transfers and extra services require their own quote.

Currency conversions help you compare prices and may differ from your payment provider’s rate. Your written quotation specifies the payable currency, taxes, government charges and service charges that apply. No payment processor operates on this website. Use only payment instructions confirmed by our sales team.

Cancellation, refunds and no-shows

Cancellation conditions belong to the specific product, option and travel date. Review the conditions on its page and in your written quotation. Some bookings are non-refundable; others have a stated cancellation deadline and charge. A general policy does not override an option-specific condition.

  • Send cancellation requests in writing by WhatsApp or email with your booking reference. Cancellation takes effect when our team confirms it; we also confirm charges, any refund and its expected timing.
  • For a discounted combination, cancelling one component removes the combination price. Retained services are recalculated at their individual standard prices; any refund is the difference after applicable conditions.
  • Tourist visa application fees become non-refundable once payment is processed. The visa page and written quotation identify any additional application or service-fee conditions.
  • Missing a confirmed service normally means no refund for the unused service. Rescheduling after a no-show requires written agreement.
  • Eligible refunds follow the confirmed product policy and payment-provider processing. If that policy states seven working days, that timeframe applies. Refund destination is confirmed with you; this website has no customer wallet.

Ask our team about amendments before the applicable deadline. Requests for different dates, traveller names or services depend on the booked terms and availability; they are not automatically accepted.

Hotels, transfers and travel details

Hotel names, room preferences, meal requests and transfer arrangements must appear in the written confirmation to be included. A requested category or hotel is not guaranteed by selecting it on this website. Where a comparable alternative is proposed, review the revised arrangement before proceeding. Check-in, check-out, admission and pickup instructions follow the confirmed hotel or experience.

Provide accurate traveller names, ages, dates, contact information and assistance needs. Review confirmations promptly and carry the identification, tickets and travel documents required for your trip. Ask before travel if any detail is unclear.

Visa assistance and eligibility

We assist applicants from different nationalities, subject to current destination rules and individual eligibility. Nationality, residence, passport, travel purpose and immigration history can affect the route available. Our assistance is not a government decision, legal representation, or a guarantee of a visa, appointment, processing time or admission at the border. Government authorities decide applications and entry.

Official fees and our service charges are separate items in your quotation. Review the applicable non-refund conditions before payment. Do not assume an indicative processing time is a promised travel deadline.

Changes and service concerns

Weather, venue operations, government restrictions or transport disruption can affect a trip. We explain material changes and the options available under the confirmed booking conditions. Contact our human support team promptly with your booking reference if you need assistance. Travel insurance is worth considering for risks beyond the booking’s refund terms.

Website use and content

Use this website lawfully and provide accurate enquiry information. Do not interfere with the website or misuse another person’s details. Brand material and original writing belong to their respective owners; photographs remain subject to their licences and any required credits.

We work to keep information accurate, but dated references may change. Nothing here removes mandatory consumer rights or responsibility that cannot lawfully be excluded. Applicable Indian law and any mandatory protections relevant to your booking remain in effect.

Questions about these terms

Email inquire@raahhi.com or use our Contact page. Keep your written quotation and booking confirmation. Last updated: 25 October 2026.

Your information

Privacy policy

This explains how Raahi Tourism PVT LTD, trading as RAAHHI TOURS, handles information on raahhi.com and in your travel enquiries.

Information you choose to provide

Enquiry forms may ask for your name, email, phone number, destination, dates, nationality, residence, travel purpose and applicant count. Activity and holiday enquiries can include guests, children’s ages, rooms, hotel preferences, transfers, meals and optional assistance needs. Share only information needed for your enquiry. There is no passport or document upload facility on this website.

Preparing and sending an enquiry

Our forms validate your entries and build a summary in your browser. They do not send a message to our server or automatically submit an application. The WhatsApp and email buttons prepare your contact details, preferences and page link for the chosen communication service. Review and press Send in that app to deliver the enquiry. Opening the app alone is not a delivery confirmation.

The handoff passes message information to the app or service you choose. WhatsApp, your email provider and your browser handle that information under their own policies; prefilled links can also be present in browser history. Detailed inclusions and cancellation paragraphs remain in your on-page summary and can be copied if needed. The website does not intentionally persist enquiry fields in cookies or browser storage. Browser autofill and draft handling follow your device settings.

How our team uses received information

Once you send an enquiry, our human team uses the information to respond, understand your trip, check options and eligibility, prepare a quotation, and handle the services you choose. If you proceed, we may share necessary traveller and booking information with the operators, hotels, transport providers, application centres or authorities involved in arranging your service. Information relevant to a service abroad may be handled outside India.

We request additional information only when needed for your chosen service. We do not offer newsletter signup or sell enquiry details through this website. For booking records, corrections, refunds or application updates, contact the team using your enquiry or booking reference.

External services and browser storage

Fonts are served from this website. Some photographs load from external image hosts. Loading those images sends normal network information such as your IP address and browser details to their providers. Enquiry fields are not deliberately included in image requests.

The website stores your selected display currency and a cached exchange-rate record in browser storage where available. These help preserve your currency choice; they are separate from enquiry fields. Copy buttons place the chosen summary on your device clipboard, which is controlled by your device and browser. No advertising or site-owned visitor analytics is enabled by this implementation, and no payment processor is connected.

Retention and information requests

Unsent form entries remain in your browser until cleared or the page is closed, subject to browser behaviour. For messages and booking information received by our team, we keep information for the period needed to handle your enquiry or service, resolve issues and meet applicable record-keeping requirements. We do not promise a fixed deletion period that may conflict with an active booking or required records.

To ask about information held by us, request a correction or deletion, or raise a privacy concern, email inquire@raahhi.com. We may need to verify that the request concerns your information. We explain any limits that apply to the request.

Our business and contact

Raahi Tourism PVT LTD, trading as RAAHHI TOURS. Office: Sr No 33/2, Ashtavinayak Rd, MITCON Lane, Balewadi, Pune, Maharashtra 411045, India. Customer and privacy contact: inquire@raahhi.com; +91 7678572029. Support hours: 8:00 am–9:00 pm IST.

We update this policy when the website’s handling of information changes. Last updated: 25 October 2026.
